1
Bhain Sughra Nu Akbar Teriyan Tangan Haye Maar Muka Gayiyan.
Raat Din Rowan De Was Pa Gayiyaan.
ALLAH Janrey Kiwein Bazaraan Choon.
Naal Phophiyaan De Lang Gaya Ho Si.
Ghairatan Abid Nu Khoon Rawa Gayiyaan.
Roye Sughra Tham Ke Chadar Nu.
Khab Jis Din Da Takiya Sham De Wich.
Bhaina Abbas Diyaan Be Rida Gayiyaan.
Haal Asghar Kiwein Sughra Da Likhaan.
Khali Ghar Di Veraniyaan Kiwein.
Fatima Sughra Nu Haye Kha Gayiyaan.

item.text:
Reconstructed all 11 verses in Shahmukhi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. The verses use Punjabi grammar and vocabulary, so I updated the language metadata to Panjabi (`pa-Arab`) and removed the missing-source tag.

I rendered the ambiguous Roman readings “janrey” as `جانے` and “Khab” as `خواب`. Only the selected lyric was edited.
